data.gender_notes: Nejla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root n-j-l, which means 'to hide' or 'to veil'. In Islamic culture, Nejla represents the young girl who hides her innocence and purity from the world, preserving it for her future husband. The name Nejla carries the meaning “Young girl” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nejla usually hope their child will grow to embody young girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
